ctx.x: But he came up with all this flash, and I was just petrified. That was it. For me, that was it. Nobody else, Jo Jones. From then on, see?
: And, after all, he had a terrific influence on the whole scene.

items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: I got Gus Johnson because I knew Gus

ctx.x: for two weeks. They went to Boston; J. C. played with the band 9 days and left. They came to me and said, "Where can I find a drummer?" I got Gus Johnson because I knew Gus and I knew Gus had tried to play bass. I mean, he was a musician and he knew all about it. I said, "Well, you can play in there." I went down to Nol Studio and rehearsed the band. I said, "You got the job." And Gus stayed there till Basie's band broke up, you know, '50 or '51.
Then he went with a small band.
